verdicts.reason: Both break the lockup in the same way. The rules that frame LAVANDER are shifted far right (about x 385–632), so they cut through the end of the word and hang past it. SKINCARE has shrunk to unreadable size, and the text block floats left of centre inside the label card, with dead space on its right. A is slightly worse: its left LOTION rule has drifted onto the lavender sprig at far left (about x 150), while the mortar is enlarged and crowds the bowl. In B, the two LOTION rules at least sit on either side of the text, though at uneven distances, and the product row is better spaced.
